Found the notes! For LEDGERLIB-107: The sequence restarts every calendar year. If `last_number` is from an earlier year than `year`, the next number should be CN-<year>-0001 (e.g., after "CN-2024-0173", the first of 2025 is "CN-2025-0001").

Found them! For `parse_transaction`: The memo is everything after the third separator. Only the first three ';' split fields are used; any subsequent ';' characters should be treated as part of the memo text and not rejected.
